_comment: Readable names for committees the FEC registry lists only as initials.
WHY THIS FILE HAS TO EXIST. The obvious assumption is that joining a
filed abbreviation to the FEC committee registry resolves it. It does
not: the registry carries the SAME string. C00571703 is named 'SLF PAC'
in the registry, C00495028 is 'HMP', C00504530 is 'CLF'. The
CONNECTED_ORG_NM column does not help either and is often unrelated —
it gives WinSenate as 'SMP', HMP as 'MINNESOTA SECOND DISTRICT VICT'
So the expansion is OUR annotation, not FEC data, and it is marked as
such on every record (`name_source: "alias_file"`). A dashboard that
silently presented these as the registry's own names would be
ONLY WELL-DOCUMENTED COMMITTEES ARE LISTED. Where we do not know what
an abbreviation stands for it is left out and the filed name shown
as-is. Guessing at an expansion would attach a political identity to a
committee on no evidence, which is worse than showing initials.
`affiliation` describes who the committee is understood to back. It is
descriptive of the committee's stated purpose, NOT a claim about any
candidate, and must never be rendered as a candidate's own property.
